summary: Stardust Power Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement amendment on September 22, 2026, updating the maximum amount of common stock sellable under its existing At Market Issuance Sales Agreement with B. Riley Securities. The amendment permits up to $6,076,872 in additional shares under General Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3, following $5,793,011 sold in the prior 12 months. SDST last traded at $0.127 on September 21, 2026, with a public float of approximately $20.1 million. This is a routine shelf takedown amendment, not a special situation.
